nodes.title: SG-8.3.3 Rewrite repo-root context.md to the real stack and modules
nodes.body:
Context: the repo-root context.md still says the repo holds only README.md and is full of UNKNOWN placeholders, so the context.md unit tests fail. game/docs/GDD.md already holds the feature index, and no file in game/src or game/frontend/src exceeds 200 lines. Desired behavior: context.md names TypeScript, Phaser 3.90, React, Zustand, Radix, Vitest and Go (backend), lists real module paths, and has no stale text or UNKNOWN. Why: docs must match the code.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the repo-root context.md, when contextDoc and contextStack tests run, then all context.md tests pass
- Given game/src and game/frontend/src, when the size and import scan tests run, then no file exceeds 200 lines and game/src has no import from game/frontend
- Given game/docs/GDD.md, when gddIndex.test.ts runs, then every indexed path exists


## Scope
- In scope: context.md content contract
- In scope: GDD index check
- In scope: size and import scan confirmation
- Out of scope: backend/ Go code and the contribution/round API
- Out of scope: new features, content or art
- Out of scope: Phaser 4 migration
- Preserve: Phaser pinned at ~3.90.0 and the phaser-pin guard test
- Preserve: gameplay unchanged
- Preserve: existing tests, none deleted or skipped
- Preserve: Zustand store as only GameState owner


## Technical constraints
- Phaser stays pinned at ~3.90.0
- npm test and npm run typecheck pass in game/ and game/frontend/
- No source file in game/src or game/frontend/src over 200 lines
- game/src never imports from game/frontend
- No test is deleted or skipped
- backend/ (Go) is out of scope


## Definition of done
- All three requirements delivered with Act and Verify units green


## Clarifying questions
- None
